subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama `timeoutSeconds` become a progress-refreshed idle timeout during streaming, or must it remain a documented total guarded-fetch cap?
rationale: The code fix matches sibling streaming wrappers, but it changes a documented provider timeout contract that existing users may rely on for a hard stream budget.

options.title: Accept Idle Semantics After Proof
options.body: Update the Ollama timeout docs and require redacted live remote/slow Ollama proof before merging this narrower stream fix.

options.title: Preserve A Total Cap
options.body: Keep the existing documented hard cap and use a separate idle timeout or lower-level body wrapper only if maintainers want both limits.

options.title: Pause For Root-Cause Proof
options.body: Hold the PR until the linked issue has a live reproduction showing that per-chunk timeout refresh is the actual failing boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Idle Semantics After Proof
recommendation.body: Update the Ollama timeout docs and require redacted live remote/slow Ollama proof before merging this narrower stream fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and PR metadata point to this account as the closest active owner of the Ollama stream file and timeout path.
